positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed full-stack applications across across a series of micro-services using modern industry-adopted frameworks and languages such as Javascript, React, and Go
- Collaborated with team in an agile environment to develop based off technical requirements
- Optimized applications security and ability to interact with multiple APIs and databases
- Worked closely with the app development team including project manager and developers to determine best practices.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
- Developed front end UI and created custom components for mobile applications using React Native
- Developed and supported a series of micro-services for a fulfillment inventory system using Go
- Performed tests to debug and make sure projects met all essential specifications.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Worked in team of three to design and implement an authentication/authorization service using REST API's, Go, and PostgreSQL 
- Specialized in server backend development, including REST interfaces for web applications
- Participated in all phases of system design with emphasis on planning analysis, evaluation, integration, testing, and acceptance phases

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Participated in the development of a virtual reality game used to teach Spanish with Unity 3D engine.
- Reviewed product specifications, created design documentations and wrote test plans
- Worked in team of 3 in authoring a research paper on the effects of teaching in a immersive environment
